# Pull request

## Problem and result

Explain the concrete problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or planning section.

## Validation

Describe checks actually run and their results. Distinguish unrun checks and known limitations. Include screenshots for UI changes and migration notes for compatibility changes.

## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows conventional commit format.
- [ ] I ran `npm ci --ignore-scripts` and `npm run check`.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant tests match the change.
- [ ] No credentials, private data, or unrelated generated files are included.
- [ ] I have permission to contribute this work under Apache-2.0 and have included required third-party notices.
